verdict.rationale: Paxos exposes a conventional OAuth-authenticated REST API whose endpoints work at the business level. These cover orchestrations that convert USD to stablecoins and transfer in one call, redemption to a bank, conversions, transfer list/get, and webhooks, which implies developers never run nodes. However, nothing explicitly states that gas or chain mechanics are abstracted, and no client libraries or SDKs are evidenced; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404, so generated clients are not available either. Missing for 10: official client libraries/SDKs in common languages, explicit documentation that gas, fees and node operations are handled by the platform, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
